name: mirage
text: Partly. The live tail model (late-game, far strikes) prices from ESPN's score and clock plus Novig's own prices. ESPN's win probability is only a cross-check, never a price: it was added on 2026-10-20 and can only hold a moneyline call back, when the model backs a side that ESPN rates 25 points less likely. It never creates or sizes a bet. If you want it to count more (for example as a second opinion that scales the stake), tell me and I'll build it, but I'd want some paper results on it first.
